action.prompt:
A GDScript file was just saved in the swap-attack project. Quickly check it against these project conventions from the steering file and flag any violations:
1. All shared numeric constants (grid size, timing, scoring) must live in Constants.gd — never re-defined in other scripts.
2. Use signals for cross-node communication (block_cleared, chain_updated, game_over, etc.) — not direct method calls across unrelated scene branches.
3. Player input must reference Input Map action names (ui_left, ui_right, ui_up, ui_down, swap) — never hard-coded KEY_* constants.
4. Pure logic helpers should use `static func` where no node context is needed.
5. Row 0 = top, row 11 = bottom; cursor col identifies the LEFT cell of its 2-cell span.
6. Every script intended to be referenced by type elsewhere must have a `class_name` declaration.

If the file looks clean, say so briefly. Only flag real issues — don't nitpick style.
